concept: a puddle of lamp-oil that learned to want, creeping toward any open flame
a scarecrow that wandered off its post and now stands in a different field each morning
a drowned ferryman who still poles his barge across the black river and takes the fare from your breath
a reliquary knight, a hollow suit built around a saint's fingerbone that will not let a lie be spoken near it
a granary daemon of wet rot that fills the dark with spores and hollows out whoever breathes them
a highwayman with a crossbow who marks a rich coach by lantern-signal and follows it for miles
the last salt-giant, who weeps brine and whose tears crust the ground into shards
a tavern's hearth-spirit gone bitter, that warms nobody now and chills the room when the songs start
a cliff-nesting hunter bird with a wingspan like a sail that carries off goats and, lately, children
